newsitem.title: CANADA: Mitel to take Q4 charge, sees earnings fall.
newsitem.headline: Mitel to take Q4 charge, sees earnings fall.

text.p: Mitel Corp said on Monday it will take a C$13 million pre-tax restructuring charge in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 to cut operating expenses at business communications systems.

The company also said it expects its pre-charge fourth quarter results to fall below market expectations because of continuing pricing pressures and higher operating costs on a global basis for business communications systems.
Mitel said it expects fourth quarter earnings before the charge to be about C$0.10 per share, down from C$0.14 per share in the prior-year period.
